Author: Shao
Name: SubSync
Punchline: Automatically syncs useful data regarding the status of your FC subs to a shared Google Sheet.
Description:
A simple plugin that allows friends to collaborate on sending out Free Company submarines by syncing useful data from each person to a central Google Sheet and dashboard. This allows realtime visibility of when subs will return and need to be sent out again, as well as what consumables/salvage they have available.

Please note that this was made exclusively for Whispering Woods, and requires specific infrastructure in order to use.
